text: In the Bhagavad Gita, Sri Krishna teaches us:
Ego makes us feel, "I am the doer of everything."
When that feeling of "I" melts away from our hearts, and our heart says, "You are my only refuge...
I place my life in Your hands," then Lord Venkateswara is right there—
He is the Lord who showers endless love and compassion on those who trust Him as their only refuge, leave their ego at His feet, and completely surrender themselves to Him.
Sri Krishna's teaching in the Dvapara Yuga.
Lord Venkateswara's divine name in the Kali Yuga.
These are two forms of the same eternal journey...
This is one of the most beautiful journeys Sanatana Dharma guides us on—
Until we completely surrender ourselves to Him.
